about:
Hi! I'm Sai Sreenadh. I'm a Computer Science and Engineering (AI & ML) student at VIT-AP, passionate about building software that sits at the intersection of thoughtful design, engineering, and artificial intelligence.
 I enjoy turning ideas into practical products — from full-stack web applications and developer tools to machine learning and GenAI projects. My work spans technologies like Next.js, React, Python, FastAPI, Node.js, and PyTorch, with a growing focus on AI/ML and intelligent systems.
 Outside of code, I'm usually playing a game, exploring something new in tech, or getting lost in a good book. I'm driven by curiosity and the idea that there's always something new worth building, learning, or breaking apart to understand.
aboutEloborate:
Hello! I’m Sai Sreenadh, a passionate Full-Stack Developer currently pursuing a B.Tech degree. I specialize in creating intuitive and responsive user interfaces with tools like Next.js and Figma, while also ensuring seamless backend functionality using Node.js and Express. My focus is on building user-friendly, efficient web applications that merge both technical proficiency and creative design.
I’m committed to continuously learning and evolving in the fast-paced world of technology, always seeking innovative solutions and staying up-to-date with the latest tools and trends in web development.

timeline.title: Sri Chaitanya Educational Institutions (MPC)
timeline.content: At Sri Chaitanya, I focused on building a strong foundation in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. This background sharpened my analytical and problem-solving skills, which I continue to apply in my development work. It was here that I first developed a passion for technology, which later led me to pursue a career in full-stack development.

timeline.title: Vellore Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh
timeline.content: Currently pursuing my B.Tech degree in Computer Science at VIT, I am gaining a deeper understanding of full-stack development, data structures, artificial intelligence, and modern web technologies. My time here has been instrumental in expanding my skill set in both front-end and back-end development, preparing me for the tech industry.
